_note_portfolioResidualQuantileWad: PROVISIONAL PLACEHOLDER, not calibrated (see _provisional above; replaced by the Phase 4 grid sweep). Derivation: forecast.ts's lowerBoundAt computes horizonMu = annualisedRateWad * horizonSeconds / SECONDS_PER_YEAR, then adds this quantile (<=0). At horizonSeconds=604800 (7d) the conversion factor is 604800/31536000 = 0.0191781, so a reference 5% APY venue (WAD-scale rate 5e16, mid-range for these lending markets) has a 7-day horizon return of 5e16 * 0.0191781 = 9.589e14. The PREVIOUS value here, -2e15, was LARGER IN MAGNITUDE than that entire reference return (and than an 8% APY venue's 1.534e15) so it drove every venue's lower bound negative and the optimiser deployed nothing, forever, with no error -- see task-11-report.md. This value, -1e13, is about 1% of the 5% reference horizon return: solving horizonMu + q = 0 for r gives a breakeven APY of only ~0.052%, so it stays out of the way of any realistically-yielding venue while remaining a strictly negative (conservative) shrink. It is NOT a calibrated dispersion estimate -- it exists only to let the pipeline admit and deploy capital in Phase 1; a later phase replaces it with a real quantile from completed-label residuals.
